images.alt: Copy of a book held in front of Hayley C's face. Text below the image reads: This is one of the books that I read when I was young. This collection of short stories by national artist Nick Joaquin feels deeply rooted in who we are as Filipinos. Each story brought to life our traditions, beliefs, and sense of identity in a what that felt both familiar and meaningful.
